topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can’t believe my car was towed from my own driveway. It’s so frustrating, but I know things like this can happen to anyone. I’m trying not to get too upset because I don’t want to let it ruin my day. I’ve called the tow company and they were actually quite helpful. They told me where the car is and how to get it back. I’m heading over there soon, and I’m hoping it all gets sorted out smoothly. I’m grateful for the support from my family and friends, who’ve been checking in to see if I need any help. It’s nice to know I’m not alone in this.
